meta.title: Word-level diff
meta.description: Adds intra-line highlighting to the changed-files review. In a turn's changed files, open a file to see its comparison in the right sidebar: removed words inside a red line get a deeper red and inserted words inside a green line get a brighter green, so a word or two edited inside a long line is visible at a glance instead of repainting the whole line. Only a rewritten line is marked: a line that was purely added or purely deleted keeps its line colour alone, and a pair whose marks would cover most of the line is drawn plain as well. The header carries the file picker, side-by-side / unified, wrap, and word-highlight toggles. It reads only the comparison the Harness already serves — no extra diffs, no files read — and turning the plugin off restores the built-in review.
